subject: general
question: Gooseberry is a rich source of which vitamin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gooseberry, also known as Amla in India, is widely recognized for its high Vitamin C content.
 
• Vitamin C is essential for the growth, development, and repair of all body tissues.
 
• It is involved in many body functions, including the formation of collagen, absorption of iron, the immune system, wound healing, and the maintenance of cartilage, bones, and teeth.
 
• 100 grams of Amla contains approximately 300 mg of Vitamin C, which is significantly higher than many other fruits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin A:**

 
 
• It is vital for maintaining healthy vision, skin, and immune function.
 
• Rich sources of Vitamin A include carrots, sweet potatoes, and dark leafy greens.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin D:**
 
 
• It helps in the absorption of calcium, promoting bone and dental health.
 
• The body produces Vitamin D when exposed to sunlight, but it can also be found in foods like fatty fish, liver, and fortified dairy products.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin B:**
 
 
• This group of vitamins plays a crucial role in cell metabolism and energy production.
 
• Sources include whole grains, meat, eggs, and dairy products.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin C:**
 
 
• Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) is an essential nutrient involved in the repair of tissue and enzymatic production of certain neurotransmitters.
 
• It is a powerful antioxidant and helps in the protection against immune system deficiencies, cardiovascular disease, prenatal health problems, eye disease, and even skin wrinkling.
 
• In addition to gooseberries, other sources of Vitamin C include oranges, strawberries, kiwi, bell peppers, broccoli, and Brussels sprouts.
